digest.component_or_area: rebar init CLI and store initialization
propositions: rebar init silently creates an orphan divergent store when fetch of configured tickets branch fails or times out, instead of failing closed with diagnostic
tri-state remote-branch probe (advertised, reachable-absent, unreachable) must be shared by four init code paths and cached per invocation to ensure at most one probe timeout
unreachable remote must prevent orphan bootstrap unless --force-new-store flag explicitly supplied; reachable-absent and advertised-but-fetch-failed must fail nonzero without orphaning
ensure_store_mounted_best_effort must treat unreachable as do-not-auto-mount, never supply force_new_store=True, and allow strict auto-init to reuse cached probe result
advertisement probe via git ls-remote must use short timeout separate from 300-second cold fetch bound, converting TimeoutExpired to exit code 124
error messages must name configured remote, configured branch, timeout where applicable, and provide concrete fetch/retry or force-new-store remediation
